name: io.github.jkanselaar/python-code-validator
title: Python Code Validator
description: Validates, repairs and hardens AI-generated Python. validate_python checks without running it: syntax, lint and type diagnostics with line and column, an AST security policy, a credential scan and the mistakes a linter allows — an unawaited coroutine, a method without self, a swallowed exception. repair_python returns the fixed source; execute_python additionally runs it in a sandbox.
